offering_description.value: Operates a fleet of specialized fixed-wing aircraft, including water-scooping Super Scoopers and air attack planes, providing aerial wildfire suppression and surveillance. Customers are mainly federal and state government agencies, served under exclusive-use and call-when-needed contracts. Also provides aircraft maintenance.

primary_services.value: aerial firefighting; air attack and fire surveillance; aircraft maintenance and modification; wildfire management support

customer_segment.value: B2G: US Forest Service, Department of the Interior, state agencies, and Canadian and European governments

end_markets.value: wildfire management; public safety; emergency response; forestry and land management

revenue_model.value: project or contract: exclusive-use contracts with fixed availability fees from government agencies; service fees: flight-hour and call-when-needed fees for aircraft deployment

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and flies firefighting and surveillance aircraft, selling services to government fire agencies; service provider: aircraft maintenance, repair and modification through in-house maintenance unit

geography_served.value: global: United States western states, Montana, Minnesota, plus Canada and southern Europe

specialization.value: related lines: aerial firefighting, air surveillance and aircraft maintenance

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: government contract bids and agreements with federal, state and foreign agencies

regulatory_exposure.value: high: aviation operations under FAA certification and government contracting rules, foreign aviation authority rules

notes: Details from general knowledge; fleet size and international footprint may have changed.
